obligations.summary: The Commission shall develop guidelines on the practical implementation of this Regulation, covering requirements and obligations for high-risk AI systems, prohibited practices, substantial modification, transparency obligations, relationship with other Union law, and the definition of an AI system.

When issuing guidelines, the Commission shall pay particular attention to the needs of SMEs including start-ups, local public authorities, and the sectors most likely to be affected by this Regulation.

The Commission's guidelines shall take due account of the generally acknowledged state of the art on AI, as well as relevant harmonised standards, common specifications referred to in Articles 40 and 41, and technical specifications set out pursuant to Union harmonisation law.
At the request of Member States or the AI Office, or on its own initiative, the Commission shall update previously adopted guidelines when deemed necessary.
